verdict.rationale: Unleash documents its own one-time scheduling. You can schedule a feature release for a specific date and time with a currentTime DATE_AFTER constraint, apply grouped change requests at a set point in time, and use release templates that progress through milestones automatically while monitoring health. Nothing in the evidence shows recurring schedules or general job or workflow scheduling. missing for 10: recurring/cron-style scheduling, a general job or workflow scheduler, API or MCP-driven scheduling for agents, independent corroboration.
